_comment: EXPECTED TO DIFFER PER SITE. The budgets tests/page-weight.spec.ts checks (decoded kilobytes).
Set 2026-10-27 from what each page weighed (Playwright, chromium) plus about 25%. Route keys match tests/routes.ts (no trailing slash).
Keys left out fall back to the spec's own numbers. A route that must be heavy gets its own entry under pages, with the reason in _why.
jsonLd lists the schema.org types a route must carry, e.g. { "/": ["Organization"] }.

maxScriptKb lowered from 430 to 120 by overhaul 1.4 (2026-10-30): the React chrome islands became small .astro scripts, so every route except /photography ships no React (/photography joined them in overhaul 2.8). Measured after (with 1.2 merged): about 16 KB of script files per route (the chrome scripts are small enough that Astro inlines them), against about 342 KB before. The margin leaves room for the overhaul's own scripts (1.7's motion switch and the like) without hiding a framework creeping back. The /contact override (2650 KB) went the same day: its 2101 KB was React plus the form libraries, and /contact now weighs what every other page does. Since overhaul 2.7 (2026-10-31) the Google Maps iframe is gone altogether (a static inline SVG replaced it), so /contact makes no third-party map request and sits on the defaults.

/._why: The hero reel shows real client sites as images (about 13 small WebP captures, 2026-10-30). The WebGL hero and its 1237 KB of three.js were removed the same day, so scripts fall back to the default budget. Lowered from 770 by overhaul 4.4 (2026-10-31): the Selected Work frames below the reel became AVIF with honest `sizes`, and the page measured 325 KB of images in Playwright chromium at 1280x720 (446 before). The budget is that plus about 25%. The reel itself stays WebP (AVIF came out larger at its quality).

/work/stone-steps-50k._why: The sample case study (Stone Steps, since 2026-10-30). Lowered by overhaul 2.4b (2026-10-31): the site showcase became 'Walk the homepage', which crops the 1440x10824 capture to its first 4,000px at build time (ruling 4) and drops the floating phone. Lowered again by overhaul 4.4 (2026-10-31): every study image is now AVIF with a WebP fallback, and Playwright chromium at 1280x720 measured 212 KB of images on load (270 before 4.4), the largest one the 94 KB AVIF stage capture. The budgets are those plus about 25%. Scrolled to the bottom at 1440 the page loads 744 KB (906 before), with the walk capture now served at the width its box really has.
